name: antigravity
description: Delegate a task to Google's Antigravity CLI (agy) over ACP, with every read, edit and command it asks for answered by a mode the plugin enforces: read-only questions, reviews and searches, or an implementation in a throwaway worktree that comes back as a patch.

agyPath.title: agy CLI path
agyPath.description: Absolute path of the agy executable; leave empty to look on PATH, then in ~/.local/bin, /opt/homebrew/bin and /usr/local/bin.

defaultModel.title: Default model
defaultModel.description: agy model id a task uses when it names none (antigravity-delegate models lists them); leave empty for agy's own default.
